meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户报告 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的缺陷时，Claude 会先调试并核对两处源码，判断该归哪个仓库，再产出一份含复现步骤、根因和修复建议的英文 GitHub issue 或 PR，并查重、加标签后提交或评论。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等项目的缺陷，尤其是需要根因、复现步骤或修复指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告 LazyCodex 插件安装失败的 bug，给出根因和修复建议。
say.note: 会生成一份带源码证据的 issue 草稿。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 崩溃像上游问题，请核实并路由到正确的仓库。
把刚才的复现步骤整理成 issue，发到对应的 GitHub 仓库。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a reported bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI into a GitHub issue or PR with source-backed root cause, repro steps, and fix guidance, after finding the right repo and checking duplicates.
howto.when_en: Use when the user reports or triages a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or Codex CLI bug, especially for root-cause analysis, repro steps, fix guidance, or GitHub routing.

say_en.text: Help me file a LazyCodex plugin install bug with root cause.
This Codex CLI crash looks upstream; verify and route it to the correct repo.
say_en.note: Claude checks source before choosing the repo.

say_en.text: Turn my repro steps into an issue and file it on the owning GitHub repo.
say_en.note: Claude checks duplicates and adds lazycodex-generated label.
